fields.Intake — Published:
120 standard MBA seats, 2026–27 official admission brochure. Separate MBA Business Analytics & Data Science 40 seats excluded.
Published numeric intake: 120
fields.Fees — Published:
Official 2026–27 standard MBA academic fee ₹1,10,000 per semester × 4 = ₹4.40 lakh. Library ₹750, sports ₹750 and exams ₹2,500 per semester × 4 = ₹16,000; one-time registration ₹10,000. Total academic net ₹4.66 lakh; refundable security ₹10,000 extra.
Numeric fee reference ₹L: 4.66
fields.Fee Scope: Standard MBA two years, 2026–27 brochure pages 49–52. Includes academic, library, sports, examination and registration fees; excludes ₹10,000 refundable security, application fee and optional hostel/mess. Separate Business Analytics & Data Science has a different semester fee.
fields.Accepted Exams: CUET, CAT, MAT, GMAT, CMAT or XAT; direct admission on qualifying-degree merit is also listed.
fields.Eligibility: Graduation in any discipline from recognised university/college with 50% aggregate; 45% for reserved categories.
fields.Selection Process: Valid accepted test score or direct admission on qualifying-degree merit, per official 2026–27 brochure.
